description: Statistical test and figure: active-site conservation in primate LPA versus primate PLG orthologs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
both=pd.read_csv("out/LPA_vs_PLG_triad_primates.csv")
print("Fisher exact tests, conservation in primate LPA vs primate PLG:")
res=[]
for col,ref,lbl in [("his57","H","His57 (catalytic His)"),("asp102","D","Asp102"),
                    ("ser195","S","Ser195 (catalytic Ser)"),("p1","R","P1 of activation site")]:
    t={}
    for g in ["LPA","PLG"]:
        v=[x for x in both[both.gene==g][col] if isinstance(x,str) and x!="?"]
        t[g]=(sum(x==ref for x in v), len(v)-sum(x==ref for x in v))
    tab=[[t["LPA"][0],t["LPA"][1]],[t["PLG"][0],t["PLG"][1]]]
    orr,p=fisher_exact(tab)
    print(f"  {lbl:24s} LPA {t['LPA'][0]}/{sum(t['LPA'])}  PLG {t['PLG'][0]}/{sum(t['PLG'])}   Fisher p = {p:.2e}")
    res.append(dict(site=lbl, LPA_cons=t['LPA'][0], LPA_n=sum(t['LPA']), PLG_cons=t['PLG'][0], PLG_n=sum(t['PLG']), p=p))
pd.DataFrame(res).to_csv("out/conservation_fisher.csv",index=False)

# ---------- figure ----------
lpa=both[both.gene=="LPA"].copy()
order=["Homo sapiens","Pan troglodytes","Gorilla gorilla","Pongo abelii",
       "Macaca mulatta","Macaca fascicularis","Macaca nemestrina","Chlorocebus sabaeus",
       "Papio anubis","Cercocebus atys","Piliocolobus tephrosceles"]
lpa["o"]=lpa.species.map({s:i for i,s in enumerate(order)}); lpa=lpa.sort_values("o")
cols=["p1","p1p","his57","asp102","ser195"]
labels=["P1 activation\n(PLG Arg)","P1'\n(PLG Val)","His57","Asp102","Ser195"]
ref={"p1":"R","p1p":"V","his57":"H","asp102":"D","ser195":"S"}
M=np.zeros((len(lpa),len(cols)))
for i,(_,row) in enumerate(lpa.iterrows()):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols):
        v=row[c]
        M[i,j]= 1 if v=="?" else (3 if v==ref[c] else 2)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[2.2,1]})
ax=axes[0]
cmap=plt.cm.colors.ListedColormap(["#ffffff","#cfcfcf","#c44536","#2a7f62"])
ax.imshow(M,cmap=cmap,vmin=0,vmax=3,aspect="auto")
for i,(_,row) in enumerate(lpa.iterrows()):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols):
        ax.text(j,i,row[c],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold",
                color="white" if row[c]!="?" else "#555")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(lpa))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{s}" for s in lpa.species],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-.5,len(cols),1),minor=True); ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-.5,len(lpa),1),minor=True)
ax.grid(which="minor",color="white",lw=1.6); ax.tick_params(which="minor",length=0)
ax.axhline(3.5,color="black",lw=1.6)
ax.text(4.65,1.5,"apes",rotation=-90,va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.text(4.65,7.5,"Old World\nmonkeys",rotation=-90,va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("A. Catalytic His57 is lost in every Old World monkey apo(a) sampled\n"
             "green = plasminogen residue retained, red = substituted, grey = motif not found in the RefSeq model",fontsize=10.5)

ax=axes[1]
r=pd.read_csv("out/conservation_fisher.csv")
x=np.arange(len(r)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2, r.LPA_cons/r.LPA_n*100, w, color="#c44536", label="LPA (apo(a))")
ax.bar(x+w/2, r.PLG_cons/r.PLG_n*100, w, color="#2a7f62", label="PLG (plasminogen)")
for i,row in r.iterrows():
    ax.text(i-w/2, row.LPA_cons/row.LPA_n*100+2, f"{row.LPA_cons}/{row.LPA_n}", ha="center",fontsize=8)
    ax.text(i+w/2, row.PLG_cons/row.PLG_n*100+2, f"{row.PLG_cons}/{row.PLG_n}", ha="center",fontsize=8)
    if row.p<0.05: ax.text(i, 108, f"p={row.p:.1e}", ha="center", fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(["His57","Asp102","Ser195","P1 Arg"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% of primate orthologs retaining\nthe plasminogen residue",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,120); ax.legend(fontsize=8.5,loc="lower left"); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("B. Purifying selection on the active site\nis present in PLG and absent in LPA",fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
